verdict.rationale: CSC is a SaaS entity-management and registered-agent platform that stores customer documents, so user control over data retention and deletion is an applicable axis. The evidence covers document scanning, secure delivery, storage in CSCNavigator, and APIs, but nothing documents retention settings, retention periods, or user-initiated deletion. Generic 'secure' claims are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
